levels.title: Starter
levels.description: Flat shapes and clean lines. Start here if you are new to drawing.

levels.title: Core
levels.description: Detail, overlap and 3D form. Forms comes first: everything after it builds on it.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.description: Light, depth, perspective, texture and style. Light & Shadow comes first: everything after it builds on it.

paths.title: Sky & Weather
paths.description: From a sun made of a circle and rays to a storm over the mountains: simple shapes first, then overlap, then a whole scene.

paths.title: Fruits
paths.description: Round, curved and clustered shapes, ending with four fruits overlapping in a bowl.

paths.title: Food & Treats
paths.description: Treats first, then stacked and layered food, ending with a full snack tray.

paths.title: Forms
paths.description: The skills path: boxes, cylinders, cones and spheres, then everyday objects built from them, with one light direction.

paths.title: Plants
paths.description: Trees, flowers and potted plants, from stacked triangles to a twisted bonsai, ending on a windowsill garden.

paths.title: Wheels
paths.description: Everything that rolls, from a box-shaped bus to an ambulance with its cross and roof light.

paths.title: On the Water
paths.description: Boats and ships, from one sail on a hull to a harbour scene.

paths.title: In the Air
paths.description: Things that fly, from a paper airplane to a busy sky that uses size for depth.

paths.title: Space
paths.description: Moons, planets and spacecraft, ending with the solar system drawn on orbit ellipses.

paths.title: Landscape
paths.description: Depth without buildings: overlap, size, paler distance, reflections and a road to the horizon, ending with a full mountain valley.
